root.summary: A worked status-report exemplar: where we are, what stage each workstream is in, the scoreboard by area, the one thing at risk, and what's next. Copy this shape for any recurring weekly/release-train update.

nodes.title: v0.12 release train
nodes.tagline: Weekly status — proposal mode off, reference mode on. State what's true, flag what's at risk, name what's next.

blocks.text: Three of four workstreams are green; the layout-language design is the one at-risk item.
blocks.sub: No blockers on the release itself — v0.12 ships on schedule even if the design slips a week.

blocks.lead: At risk — the layout language design.
blocks.body: The straightjacket the templates work is running into (every data-derived doc forces the same §-card stack) is real and documented in each template's loss-list. The design is in progress but not yet reviewed. It does not block v0.12 — the engine and library both ship independently of it — but it is the thing most likely to slip.
